The modifications in both files (`hclgevf_main.c` and `hclge_main.c`) are related as they both address the same issue of incorrectly reading the response data for TQP (Traffic Queue Pair) statistics. The changes ensure that the correct data position is accessed for both RX and TX statistics, aligning the implementation with the user manual. This indicates a consistent fix across different components of the HNS3 driver, ensuring that both virtual function (VF) and physical function (PF) implementations are corrected in the same manner.
